decisions: Keep `vloop self-update` for the binary and installed agent plugins, while `vloop upgrade` remains repository-local; this preserves the operator's naming decision.
Use the Go module toolchain (`go list -m -json ...@latest` and `go install ...@<version>`) as the release channel.
Install automatically only strictly newer releases; allow `--version` to request an exact older version or prerelease.
Refuse unsafe or ambiguous installs, including a checkout build, missing Go, or a binary outside the directory where `go install` writes.
Keep release discovery out of doctor and repository upgrade; update plugins only from `self-update`, with plugin failures reported but non-fatal.
Amend C-2 for this repository-independent command so install and executable paths outside a repository print with `/` and the home directory as `~`.
Fake `go`, `claude`, and `copilot` in cross-platform Go test programs; compare versions with the existing `golang.org/x/mod/semver` dependency; and define `--check --version` as a comparison.
